property_summary: Invariant: after any caller invokes addToBalance() with some wei, the caller's stored userBalance equals the previous balance plus the sent value; the mutant that sets balance to msg.value instead breaks this because it drops prior balance when msg.sender had nonzero balance.
change_summary: Move the state update that increases the caller's balance to after performing no-op (keeps same expression) — here we replace the single statement with one that sets balance to msg.value only (dropping previous balance), changing stored balances observed after addToBalance.
